title: Gene Expression Profiling to Unveil Novel Biomarkers for Early Diagnosis and Therapies for Breast Cancer.
authors: Hossain, Alomgir; Islam, Md Asadul; Khalekuzzaman, Md; Acharjee, Uzzal; Sikdar, Biswanath; Faruqe, Md Omar; Matin, Mohammad Nurul; Zaman, Rashed
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习筛选乳腺癌差异表达基因并做分子对接与MD验证，虽涉及蛋白-DNA调控网络但核心是表达谱与药物筛选，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Breast cancer (BC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. Early detection and accurate diagnosis can improve patient outcomes and survival rates. Thus, identifying drugs and biomarkers for early detection is necessary for diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Using machine learning techniques, we identified 160 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between BC and control samples from four microarray datasets (GSE26910, GSE3744, GSE29431, and GSE42568), which were adopted due to the frequent presence of outliers in microarray gene-expression datasets, stemming from multiple stages in the data generation processes. Through protein-protein interaction network analysis, 10 DEGs (FN1, CXCL10, CD34, PECAM1, PTGS2, CXCL12, JUN, EGFR, CD36, and CAV1) were selected as pivotal Hub genes (HubGs) as potential biomarkers for BC. RESULTS: We validated the expression profiles of hub genes (HubGs) in breast cancer (BC) and control samples using box plot analysis based on data from the TCGA and GTEx databases. The identified HubGs demonstrated strong prognostic potential, as shown by Kaplan-Meier survival analyses and performance in a random forest prediction model. Regulatory network analysis revealed that HubG activity is modulated at a limited number of transcriptional and posttranscriptional stages. Functional enrichment analysis highlighted key molecular functions, cellular components, biological processes, and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathways associated with BC pathogenesis and linked to these HubGs. Finally, molecular docking studies targeting HubG-mediated receptors led to the identification of seven top-ranked candidate drugs-Olaparib, Tucatinib, Telmisartan, Danazol, Troglitazone, Abemaciclib, and Lapatinib- proposed for potential BC treatment. DISCUSSION: In this study, we identified 10 critical differentially expressed genes (cDEGs)- CD34, PECAM1, PTGS2, CXCL12, JUN, EGFR, CD36, CAV1, FN1, and CXCL10-as pivotal hub genes (HubGs) involved in breast cancer (BC). These HubGs were determined through protein- protein interaction (PPI) network analysis of 160 cDEGs derived from four independent microarray datasets. Functional enrichment analysis revealed that these HubGs are associated with key biological processes, cellular components, molecular functions, and pathways relevant to BC progression. Furthermore, we identified three top-ranked transcription factors (BRCA1, STAT3, and TP53) and three microRNAs (hsa-miR-16-5p, hsa-miR-155-5p, and hsa-miR-23b-3p) as crucial regulators of HubGs, acting at both transcriptional and post-transcriptional levels. CONCLUSION: The stability of the top three receptor-ligand complexes was validated through molecular dynamics simulations. Therefore, our findings could be a valuable resource for researchers and medical professionals, aiding in BC diagnosis and treatment.
abstract_zh: 引言：乳腺癌（BC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。早期检测和准确诊断可改善患者预后和生存率。因此，识别用于早期检测的药物和生物标志物对于诊断、预后和治疗至关重要。材料与方法：利用机器学习技术，我们从四个微阵列数据集（GSE26910、GSE3744、GSE29431和GSE42568）中识别出BC样本与对照样本之间的160个差异表达基因（DEGs），这些数据集因微阵列基因表达数据中常存在异常值（源于数据生成过程的多个阶段）而被采用。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析，筛选出10个DEGs（FN1、CXCL10、CD34、PECAM1、PTGS2、CXCL12、JUN、EGFR、CD36和CAV1）作为关键枢纽基因（HubGs），作为BC的潜在生物标志物。结果：我们基于TCGA和GTEx数据库的数据，使用箱线图分析验证了乳腺癌（BC）和对照样本中枢纽基因（HubGs）的表达谱。通过Kaplan-Meier生存分析和随机森林预测模型的表现，所识别的HubGs显示出强大的预后潜力。调控网络分析揭示，HubG活性在有限数量的转录和转录后阶段受到调节。功能富集分析突出了与BC发病机制相关并关联这些HubGs的关键分子功能、细胞组分、生物学过程及京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路。最后，针对HubG介导受体的分子对接研究，识别出七种排名靠前的候选药物——奥拉帕利（Olaparib）、图卡替尼（Tucatinib）、替米沙坦（Telmisartan）、达那唑（Danazol）、曲格列酮（Troglitazone）、阿贝西利（Abemaciclib）和拉帕替尼（Lapatinib）——被提议用于潜在BC治疗。讨论：在本研究中，我们识别出10个关键差异表达基因（cDEGs）——CD34、PECAM1、PTGS2、CXCL12、JUN、EGFR、CD36、CAV1、FN1和CXCL10——作为参与乳腺癌（BC）的关键枢纽基因（HubGs）。这些HubGs通过对源自四个独立微阵列数据集的160个cDEGs进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析确定。功能富集分析揭示，这些HubGs与BC进展相关的关键生物学过程、细胞组分、分子功能和通路相关联。此外，我们识别出三个排名靠前的转录因子（BRCA1、STAT3和TP53）和三个microRNAs（hsa-miR-16-5p、hsa-miR-155-5p和hsa-miR-23b-3p）作为HubGs的关键调控因子，在转录和转录后水平发挥作用。结论：通过分子动力学模拟验证了前三个受体-配体复合物的稳定性。因此，我们的发现可为研究人员和医疗专业人员提供宝贵资源，有助于BC的诊断和治疗。
